lines: •2026 financial guidance raised to a total revenue range of $337 million to $351 million (previously between $278 million and $292 million) and an Adjusted EBITDA range of $176 million to $190 million (previously between $114 million and $128 million)

•The Company has increased its 2026 financial guidance for total revenue to be between $337 million and $351 million (previously between $278 million and $292 million) and adjusted EBITDA to be between $176 million and $190 million (previously between $114 million and $128 million), excluding the impact of any future transactions.

desk.headline: Revenue jumps to $256.5m on $250m Ziihera milestone, beat; 2026 revenue outlook raised to $337-351m

other.label: Share buybacks
other.change: 534,381 shares in Q3; $140.4m year to date

results: Revenue rose to $256.5m from $27.6m, almost all from a $250m milestone paid by partner Jazz after US approval of Ziihera for first-line HER2-positive stomach and oesophageal cancer.
Net income was $173.7m ($2.28 a diluted share) versus a $19.6m loss a year ago; adjusted EBITDA was $215.3m.
SG&A tripled to $42.7m on Theravance Biopharma deal costs, severance and share awards; R&D was flat at $36.1m.
The Theravance Biopharma takeover closed on 23 September, adding the YUPELRI royalty stream (about $1.5m of revenue in Q3) and $13-15m of expected yearly cost savings.

Zymeworks raised $600m of non-recourse debt in 2026 to fund the deal and buybacks; cash and securities fell to $100.5m, but receivables stood at $413.9m at quarter-end, largely the Jazz milestone collected in October.

guidance.summary: Zymeworks lifted its 2026 outlook: revenue of $337-351m (was $278-292m) and adjusted EBITDA of $176-190m (was $114-128m), assuming US antitrust clearance of the Roche ZW209 deal in Q4.

call.source: No call held — the company chose not to host a Q3 earnings call

watch: Antitrust clearance of the Roche ZW209 deal, which brings a $55m upfront payment and underpins the raised guidance.
Ziihera royalty growth after the first-line approval, and up to $190m in possible ex-US approval milestones.
R&D Day on 11 February 2027 and plans for ZW191 in ovarian cancer.
